solution:
**Given:**

The table showing the details of the expenditure incurred (in Rs. crores) by a tea garden during the years 2013 to 2017 is given.

**Concept used:**

Average = frac{{sum of observations}}{{no. of observations}}

**Calculation:**

Average = (60.5+68.4+62.8+67.2+84)/(5)=68.58

**∴ The average yearly expenditure on 'Salary' from 2013 to 2017 was approximately Rs 68.58 crores.**
